name: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
summary: Link, a young ranch hand in the village of Ordon, is pulled into the Twilight Realm, where he turns into a wolf. With the help of Midna, a mysterious imp, he sets out to free Hyrule from the twilight that covers it.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess HD
summary: A high-definition remaster of The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess for Wii U, with sharper graphics, a new Hero Mode and support for amiibo.
